investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Redfold Journeys (travel booking); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.7.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster redfol-prod-useast (EKS); Database: mysql server inventory-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-09f5897b0b5964185; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
